text: The whey is heated in a cauldron over a strong fire, stirred all the time. Milk and salt go in around 40 °C, and at about 90 °C the proteins flocculate and rise; the liquid must never touch the cauldron wall or boil. The French page gives no whey-to-milk ratio, no acid or rennet, and no times, so none are stated. (The English page's 'just below 100 °F / 93 °C' is garbled and was not used.)

steps.note: Ewe's and/or goat's milk (at most 25 % under the AOP), water (at most 15 %) and salt.
The proteins flocculate at about 90 °C; it never boils.
Into rush moulds (fattoghje, casgiaghji), or plastic for sale.
Only the brocciu passu, salted on the surface, is ripened, for at least 21 days.
